text: Added a test-only deterministic MUnit/ScalaCheck conformance court using the shared SCALAFIM_LAW_PROFILE and SCALAFIM_LAW_SEED controls (48-case PR and 300-case calibration profiles, one worker). Generators and invariant-preserving shrinkers cover non-ordinal IDs, permutations, selections, injections, repeated draws, equal-size foreign owners, singleton/degenerate shapes, weighted regions, fixed projections, and dense/matrix-free evidence. Public-interface laws compare both backends against independent row-major oracles for forward, adjoint, row restriction/draw, measurement, frame identity, and materialization receipts. Identity-loss and hidden-reordering mutation subjects are both killed. Evidence: mvpa JVM 157/157 and JS 157/157; 300-case generated suite passes on JVM and JS; diff/check and freeze court pass. Type-discipline review found and fixed two issues: removed locus4s implementation revision from scientific coordinate identity and removed redundant stored searchlight center/scatter ordinals in favor of typed Index values.
